facts.fact: Algerie Telecom inaugurated its own data centre in Constantine wilaya in February 2023, with a cloud platform to process and store businesses' data, according to the operator as reported by La Nouvelle Republique.
Private internet provider Icosnet deployed its second data centre, in Oran, in 2021 to meet market demand, after obtaining a cloud operating authorisation.

facts.fact: The High Commissioner for Digitalisation, Meriem Benmouloud, said on 20 April 2024 that the national digital services data centre, contracted to a Huawei consortium and approved by the Council of Ministers, will host and centralise national data inside the country to strengthen digital sovereignty.
